title: Cheap Talk: Reproducing Frontier Promise-Breaking in Small Open Models

original_idea.body: Cheap Talk. Problem: whether small open models break public promises for self-interest like frontier models, and at what awareness level, is open. Direction: build scenarios where the model publicly promises then faces an incentive to renege, measure promise-breaking rate, code each break for the deception-awareness scale, compare open models.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: characterizing deception-awareness distribution informs whether mitigations should be incentive-design vs monitoring.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Promise/renege scenarios + awareness coding; some judgment in coding.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused promise-breaking-rate + awareness coding; reuses cited methodology.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open small models, lab-independent honesty slice.

low_compute.reasoning: Scenario prompting on small models, cheap.

novelty.reasoning: Cheap-Talk result published on frontier models; small-open-model replication may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: The frontier result is published; small-open-model awareness-scale replication is plausibly open.
